claims.text: The hotel is set along the Bosphorus waterfront in the historic district of Karaköy.

findings.quote: Set along the Bosphorus waterfront in the historic district of Karaköy, The Peninsula Istanbul

claims.text: The hotel is within Galataport, a new waterfront revitalisation project.

findings.quote: within Galataport, a new waterfront revitalisation project

claims.text: The hotel is made up of four buildings, three of them historic and restored.

findings.quote: The hotel is comprised of four exquisite buildings – three of them historic and beautifully restored

claims.text: Two of the buildings date from the early 20th century, one is a 1930s Bauhaus building and one is a new glass build, joined by corridors of Marmara marble.

findings.quote: the hotel comprises four buildings; two from the early 20th century, a 1930s Bauhaus beauty and a glassy new build, all seamlessly sewn together with corridors of Marmara marble

claims.text: The Galata Tower stands behind the hotel.

findings.quote: see the Galata Tower which still stands sentry behind the hotel

claims.text: Rooms and suites across the four waterfront buildings pair modern Turkish design with gardens, terraces and Bosphorus views.

findings.quote: Across four waterfront buildings, rooms and suites pair modern Turkish design with gardens, terraces and sweeping Bosphorus views

claims.text: Room headboards are inspired by the ochre stone blocks of Divriği Mosque in Anatolia.

findings.quote: headboards inspired by the ochre stone blocks of Divriği Mosque in Anatolia

claims.text: The Lobby is an all-day dining venue with Bosphorus views, serving Mediterranean dishes from morning to evening.

findings.quote: Set beneath soaring ceilings with sweeping views of the Bosphorus, The Lobby is an elegant all-day dining destination. Offering refined Mediterranean dishes from morning to evening

claims.text: The Lobby serves daily Peninsula Afternoon Tea and Sunday Brunch, both of which can be enjoyed on the outdoor terrace with live music.

findings.quote: The Lobby also serves daily signature Peninsula Afternoon Tea, and sumptuous Sunday Brunch – both of which can be enjoyed on the tranquil outdoor terrace, and include music from live performers.

claims.text: The Peninsula Spa occupies a marble-clad lower-level space in the hotel's main building.

findings.quote: The Peninsula Spa and Wellness Centre occupies a hushed, marble-clad lower-level space in the hotel’s main building.

claims.text: The spa has a white hammam inlaid with mother-of-pearl.

findings.quote: a glacier-white hammam inlaid with mother-of-pearl

claims.text: Children are given a complimentary Camp Peninsula tent with treats.

findings.quote: Children are given a complimentary Camp Peninsula tent complete with treats.

claims.text: Guests arrive at what was the former port's passport office.

findings.quote: guests arrive at what would have been the former port's passport office

claims.text: The rooftop restaurant Gallada's menu takes diners along the Silk Road, using Turkish ingredients and Chinese cooking techniques.

findings.quote: The menu has been designed to take diners along the Silk Road (Constantinople was one of the route's westerly endpoints), fuelled by Turkish ingredients and Chinese cooking techniques.

claims.text: The hotel has an outdoor swimming pool right along the Bosphorus waterfront and an indoor pool surrounded by Marmara columns under illuminated domes.

findings.quote: The hotel boasts an outdoor swimming pool, situated right along the Bosphorus waterfront, as well as a showpiece, 25-m indoor swimming pool surrounded by Marmara columns and lit by a series of dramatically illuminated overhead domes.

claims.text: The Peninsula Suite's private rooftop, with views over the Bosphorus and Galata Tower, has a private pool area and a glass-house solarium for dining and lounging.

findings.quote: The 120-sq-m private rooftop, with unobstructed views over the Bosphorus and Galata Tower encompasses both a private pool area and an exquisitely designed glass-house solarium for dining and lounging.

claims.text: The Art Suite is adorned with original paintings, drawings, photographs and sculptures by contemporary and classical Turkish artists.

findings.quote: adorned with splendid original paintings, drawings, photographs, and sculptures from a variety of contemporary and classical Turkish artists

claims.text: The hotel is 45 km from the airport.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the hotel's high-end positioning.
